import copy
def green_centers(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append(((min(rows)+max(rows))//2,(min(cols)+max(cols))//2))
    return out
clicks=0
while True:
    gc = green_centers(current_frame)
    if not gc: break
    if clicks>20: print("too many clicks, stop"); break
    a0 = current_frame.ascii
    r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':gc[0][0],'col':gc[0][1]}])
    a1 = current_frame.ascii
    diff = sum(1 for i in range(64*64) if a0.split('\n')[i//64][i%64]!=a1.split('\n')[i//64][i%64])
    clicks+=1

    if diff>100 or res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'):
        print("BIG CHANGE or end - stopping"); break
print("remaining greens:", len(green_centers(current_frame)))
